```yaml
name: Publish to PyPI

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      # IMPORTANT: this permission is mandatory for trusted publishing
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.x"

      - name: Install build dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install build

      - name: Build package
        run: python -m build

      - name: Publish package distributions to PyPI
        uses: pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish@release/v1
```
yaml:
name: Publish to PyPI

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      # IMPORTANT: this permission is mandatory for trusted publishing
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.x"

      - name: Install build dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install build

      - name: Build package
        run: python -m build

      - name: Publish package distributions to PyPI
        uses: pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish@release/v1
